cohort: Exclusively breastfed, healthy infants born at >=36 weeks gestational age from a tertiary center in Western India.
finding: The study developed region-specific hour-specific percentile nomograms for postnatal weight loss in exclusively breastfed infants from an arid region, which showed greater early weight loss but quicker recovery after 48 hours compared to existing nomograms.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery influenced postnatal weight loss patterns, with cesarean-born infants experiencing greater median weight loss (8.7%) and a higher incidence of >=10% loss (22.4%) compared to vaginally born infants (7.4% and 9.4%, respectively).
